laptops

fixed a bunch of the laptops and now they all work.

keyboard (end?)

becuase the stock was too big to fit on our vice and adam was using the cnc machine, i went up to metal fab and faced it on metal fab's manual mill.

mr. moulis helped a lot with setting up the mill and showing me how to use their mill.

with this all done, i went back to our shop and set the dimensions of the fully faced stock.

in the meanwhile, adam also told me to adjust the adaptive clearing processies to be shorter, as the original one would take too long to be done in one day, and starting it the next day would have thet machine effectively "clear" parts that was already cleared.

with this all done, i was planning on machining the case when adam was done with the cnc machine, so i started osha 10 in the meanwhile.

before i was about to start, however, mr. christy didn't want me to do this anymore because it was a waste of stock.

while he suggested alternative methods to creating the case, i didn't like any of them so i'm ultimately quitting here.

next project?

i ended up deciding on making chamber's trademark, which is a stationary trip which explodes upon detecting people.

i plan on making a "camera" which will do something when it detects people. not quiet sure what i want it to do, but i want to add something to this enclosure to make it functional.
